Plate 1x4 (b18) placement is a best guess on top of the 1x4 bricks; the 2x3 plate (b23) carries the two red round plates in step 11.

The two Plate Special 2x2 with wheel holders (step 8) are on the underside of the base plate; each wheel pin holder is modelled as axle-hole.1/.2 with the wheel pin-hole as a revolute join; tyres are fitted on wheels.
